name: Raft InterestRatePositionManager collateral-index inflation with round-up share mint
summary: InterestRatePositionManager.liquidate resets the cbETH collateral index from the manager's cbETH balance over remaining shares, and ERC20Indexable.mint rounds shares up. The attacker donated flash-loaned cbETH, liquidated the other cbETH position to inflate the index, then made repeated 1-wei deposits each minting a full share, and borrowed unbacked R against it.
notes: The cbETH collateral registration on the manager (collateral token, debt token, price feed, splitter) is a market listing the exploit needed and is the latest change; it ran in the same block as, and after, the rcbETH-c (ERC20Indexable) deployment carrying the round-up mint.

Unbacked R is valued at what it extracted: the Balancer R pool's sDAI and DAI and the R/USDC pool's USDC in the anchor, plus 140.32 ETH (at about 2,060 USD) the attacker realised selling the remaining R through helper 0x043f64a4 over 167 later transactions.
The ETH the attacker sent to the zero address is its own loss and is not subtracted.
